node.title: The profile-covering obstruction: why naive generator designs cap (explains E12)
node.statement: A generator certificate requires the difference's 64-dim conjugate profile to match some gamma_i's profile within a factor-p^{1/phi} window per coordinate; covering arbitrary profiles needs exponentially many generators, and the e1 image is too sparse (2^122 values in a 2^390-point ball) for averaging to find full boxes. Hence: no unstructured family works, pigeonhole existence fails, and E12's linear cap is the observed shadow. The one FREE profile class: flat — (integer) x (small element) differences are self-certified.
node.notes: the scoping result that redirects the design search toward engineered (flat/near-integer) difference profiles
